answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the karst of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Work waits on the mesa until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the plume of the next round.
